anna_ml: quick dump — finished the quant-profile sweep for marlin-70b bring-up across regions (us-west, eu-west, apac-sg) and GPUs (H100, A100). attaching a short summary and config recs. TL;DR: fp8 (e4m) gives the largest throughput win with ~0.5–0.8% quality delta on our conv+persona evals; int8 (gpq) is slightly smaller speedup but with a bit more Q loss on edge slices. bf16 ~ fp16 for quality, no perf win.

mike_perf: nice. can you paste the top-line numbers (throughput speedups, p99 latency) for seq=512?

anna_ml: sure — top-line (seq=512, single-GPU median across 3 runs):
```
GPU   | mode  | throughput_rel | p50_ms | p99_ms | MRR_delta
H100  | fp16  | 1.00          | 95     | 320    | 0.00%
H100  | bf16  | 0.99          | 96     | 325    | +0.05%
H100  | int8  | 2.30          | 62     | 240    | -1.20%
H100  | fp8   | 2.70          | 55     | 210    | -0.60%
A100  | fp16  | 1.00          | 125    | 420    | 0.00%
A100  | bf16  | 0.98          | 128    | 430    | +0.03%
A100  | int8  | 1.80          | 78     | 300    | -1.35%
A100  | fp8   | 2.10          | 70     | 270    | -0.95%
```
Notes: throughput_rel is relative to fp16 baseline on same GPU. numbers are medians from 3 cold+warm mixes.

sam_infra: good detail — can you translate that into capacity sizing? say steady 1000 rps with avg 200 tokens per request (avg tokens = 200).

anna_ml: quick calc — tokens/s = 1000 * 200 = 200k tokens/s. using measured throughput (tokens/s per GPU) — approximate from above baselines: H100 fp16 ~ 30k t/s, fp8 ~ 81k t/s; A100 fp16 ~ 22k t/s, fp8 ~ 46k t/s. so recommended pools:
- H100 fp8: 3 GPUs (3 * 81k = 243k t/s) — fits with headroom for spikes.
- H100 fp16: 7 GPUs (7 * 30k = 210k t/s) — much larger cost.
- A100 fp8: 5 GPUs (5 * 46k = 230k t/s).
- A100 fp16: 10 GPUs (10 * 22k = 220k t/s).
Choice depends on cost/availability — fp8 is clearly better for capacity density.

jen_prod: any notable regional caveats? APAC drivers historically older — any kernel fallbacks?

anna_ml: yup — apac-sg images had CUDA 510 on some nodes; on H100 we had to set kernel override to "attn_compat_v1" for a subset. recommended kernel mapping:
- H100: attn_fused_v2 (use for fp8/e4m path)
- A100: attn_tiled_unfused (more stable for int8 path)
- APAC fallback: attn_compat_v1 with quant_fallback=true for nodes with older drivers
Config snippet to pin profile + kernel override:
```yaml
model_profile: marlin-70b
quant_profile: e4m-fp8
kernel_policy:
  prefer: attn_fused_v2
  fallback: attn_compat_v1
```

mike_perf: thanks. any slices where fp8 regresses more than summary? look for multi-turn persona or long-context QAs.

anna_ml: good catch — eval-bot flagged a small regression on the persona subset (turns>6): int8 spikes to -2.6% MRR on that slice, fp8 stays under -1.0% there. for chat-summary conv it’s fine. I pushed the per-slice CSV to the benchmark bucket and linked charts in the comment thread.

eval-bot: regression_alert: marlin-70b | int8 (gpq) | slice=persona-long-turns | MRR_delta=-2.6% | check: top-20 prompts. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/1745678910/results.csv :eyes:

sam_infra: ok — operationally, recommended rollout plan?

anna_ml: propose staged rollout by route:
1) Canary 5% traffic on fp8 H100 in us-west with auto-eval hooks (MRR and perplexity)
2) If no regression >1.0% on core evals after 24h -> ramp to 50%
3) On APAC, start with fp16 or int8 fallback until drivers are patched / newer nodes come up
4) Keep int8 as a separate variant for low-cost batch workloads only (not for high-quality routes)

jen_prod: sounds good. I'll open a small runbook for the canary and add runbook steps for rollback trigger thresholds (MRR drop >0.8% or p99 increase >20%).

mike_perf: can you drop the raw CSV here? I'll run some batch sims overnight.

anna_ml: pasted CSV (trimmed) below — full file in bucket.
```csv
route,region,gpu,mode,throughput_tps,p50_ms,p99_ms,mrr_delta
chat,us-west,H100,fp16,30000,95,320,0.00%
chat,us-west,H100,fp8,81000,55,210,-0.60%
chat,us-west,H100,int8,69000,62,240,-1.20%
chat,eu-west,A100,fp16,22000,125,420,0.00%
chat,eu-west,A100,fp8,46200,70,270,-0.95%
chat,apac, H100,fp16,29000,100,340,0.00%
chat,apac, H100,fp8,75000,60,230,-0.80%
```

jen_prod: perfect. I'll coordinate canary window and post the rollout plan in #product-release. :rocket:

sam_infra: will reserve H100 pool (3 gpus) in us-west for canary and pre-provision A100 fallbacks in eu. tagging infra to the PR.

anna_ml: thanks — will monitor eval hooks and post hourly summaries. ping me if you need the per-prompt diffs. :mag:

mike_perf: great work, Anna. small follow-up: can you run a quick seq=2048 p99 sample on A100 fp8? I want to confirm tail behavior before full ramp.

anna_ml: queued job now — should have numbers in ~45m, will drop them here.

eval-bot: file_uploaded: s3://benchmarks/marlin-70b/1745678910/full_report.html

jen_prod: thanks everyone. closing thread for now — will reopen if canary shows regression. :white_check_mark:
